'''Silvia''' — online as '''@ailaughatmyownjokes''' — is a sketch-comedy and roleplay creator from '''South Tyrol''', the German-speaking Alpine region of northern Italy, which is why her work slides between Italian and German. She built an enormous following on TikTok and YouTube (several million followers, and she is managed by the German influencer agency INSTINCT3), and the self-deprecating handle — "I laugh at my own jokes" — sets the tone: the comedy is loose, in-character, and fan-affectionate rather than mean. She appears in [[Media and Personalities]] as a '''YouTuber entry''', covered for what she actually makes. What sets her apart is pure performing '''range''': she plays every character herself — a one-woman cast. It is the same feat audiences praise in an actor who carries a whole film by becoming everyone in it, the Peter Sellers / Eddie Murphy / Tatiana Maslany kind of talent, done at internet speed and volume.

== The Silviaverse ==

Her signature is the '''"Silviaverse"''' — a sprawling, interconnected cast of her own invented '''original characters''', all played by Silvia, built up across recurring series rather than borrowed from existing franchises. She does the voices, the costumes, the bits, and the running continuity; the humor is offbeat, meme-forward, and tips into '''creepypasta / internet-horror-adjacent''' territory — strange, slightly unsettling, and very online rather than straight stand-up.

The flagship is '''Villain Silvia''', the star of the '''"If I were a villain"''' series: a gleeful super-villainess with an eye-patch who swears constantly and delights in committing crimes and doing evil — forever being corrected and reined in by her long-suffering assistant '''Marcus'''. Around her Silvia keeps a roster of other recurring originals that populate the same universe, so returning viewers follow characters and callbacks, not one-off gags.

== Fandom roleplay ==

Alongside the Silviaverse she is also a prolific '''fandom roleplay''' creator: short in-character sketches that imagine what a character would be like in a given setting, performed largely by herself. '''Harry Potter''' is her most-featured universe (as of early 2024), with '''The Walking Dead''', '''Scream''', and '''The Hunger Games''' appearing regularly, and many others besides. It is the same one-person-does-every-role craft turned onto worlds the audience already loves.

== Collaborations and reach ==

She frequently collaborates with her roommate '''@redheadbegins''', who makes similar videos, and the two run joint bits — including a recurring series, ''OnlyCakes''. Her reach runs to several million followers across platforms, and her videos circulate even further through reaction and compilation uploads by other creators — a sign of how recognizable her characters have become.

== Why she fits the Library ==

A performer with the '''range''' to build and voice an entire fictional universe single-handed — every character, with continuity and lore, and the same craft extended into the worlds fans already know — is the kind of talent the great multi-role actors are celebrated for, here turned into a one-woman studio. It also rhymes with ideas the Library takes seriously: the [[Egregore]] notion of a single self that holds many personae, and the internet-native, slightly-haunted storytelling the section tracks elsewhere ([[Sarah Davis Baker]]). We note her as a standout example of the form.
